thread:
ana: thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. dropping a follow-up thread specifically for the customer wins/losses section 11 post quick questions, clarifications, or anything leadership should see. ill triage.

matt: quick Q  customers keep asking for per-route cost breakdowns in the console. is that a thing were committing to?

ana: we discussed per-route billing exports in product sync. target is a CSV export + API by Q2. not shipped yet.

leah: sales reported a win because of our fallback-routing + regional failover example. can we turn that into a 1-pager "when to enable fallback" with example YAML? that was persuasive in demos.

sam: pls include a short perf caveat about quantized variants. lost a POC where quantization regressions caused hallucinations. customers want explicit testing steps.

priya: i can draft a release eval checklist for model/quantization changes. shortlist: golden prompts, latency/throughput smoke, edge-case prompts, embedding drift check. volunteer to own first pass.

derek: partner asks: per-tenant KV cache controls + eviction policy hooks. blocking one partner POC. priority?

jordan: for cost work, infra needs sample billing events. @matt can you drop an anonymized example into the infra drive?

matt: will put a sanitized sample CSV in the shared drive by EOD.

nina: question for leadership  whats our threshold for handing off POCs to solutions engineering vs SE vs CS? mixed signals in the field.

ana: good point. interim rule: solutions-eng handles infra/config POCs; SE owns feature/requirements until perf/security checklist is green; then hand to CS for long-term ops. will formalize in a short doc.

leah: also: can we capture the top 5 themes from wins/losses into playbooks? i propose: 1) fallback routing playbook, 2) quantization + eval checklist, 3) cost transparency docs, 4) per-tenant cache config, 5) SLA/enterprise onboarding steps.

sam: agree. small note  playbooks should include an "ask template" for sales to use when escalating (customer priority, blocking severity, suggested fix).

ana: action items: ana to compile top-5 and schedule triage with eng/product this week; leah + sam to draft fallback playbook; priya to draft eval checklist; matt to upload billing sample; derek to capture partner KV requirements in the ticket.

allhands-bot: Ana created task: #AH-1902 "Customer signals: wins & losses playbook" assigned to ana, leah, sam, priya. Link: https://rwd.inc/tasks/AH-1902 :spiral_calendar:

ana: closing in 48hrs unless more comments. thanks all. :handshake:
